about_the_game:
SEVERANCE

Severance is a 1–5 player online co-op horror where one of you becomes the Ghost, and the rest must investigate, survive, and escape.

🧟 Play as The Ghost
YOU are the ghost

Create terrifying moments, interact with the entire map to create unique scary scenarios, throw objects, slam doors, create ghost events and much more to mess with the investigators, all while draining their sanity, to allow you to begin hunts, chasing them down one by one until there are none left...

(AI Ghost can be chosen on multiplayer if your team chooses so)

🔎 As the Investigators

Use classic paranormal tools to gather real evidence on the ghost, find evidence to figure out who they really are. Be aware, they see and hear you. They will scare you to break you down, use this to your advantage as they will give evidence doing this

🎧 Immersive Horror
Severance features realistic visuals, environmental audio, and a minimal UI for total immersion. Every sound, shadow, and flicker could be a clue or a warning

🛠 Signature Equipment
Arm yourself with classic paranormal tools, EMF meters, Thermometers, and other unique devices  such as possession dolls to uncover evidence and track the entity’s movements

🎤Voice Interaction
Use your real voice to communicate with your team and sometimes, the ghost itself

🤝 True Co-op
Success relies on teamwork. Share discoveries, and watch each other’s backs, because you never know what the ghost will do next

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or dedicated
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Dedicated (for better 3D sound effects)

short_description: Severance is an online co-op horror game for 1-5 players. One becomes a ghost, the others are investigators. Stalk players, throw objects, slam doors, and drain their sanity, or work as a team with paranormal tools to uncover the truth.
